verification_disclaimer: All computed values were produced by copies of the repository algorithms written by the same author (Claude). They are NOT independent verification and NOT verification of the repository implementations.

canonical-json/1.object_keys: sorted; ASCII keys only (UTF-16 order equals code-point order)
canonical-json/1.strings: escaped exactly as ECMAScript JSON.stringify: quotation mark, reverse solidus, \b \f \n \r \t, other U+0000..U+001F as \u00xx lowercase; all other characters raw UTF-8
canonical-json/1.numbers: integer fields are validated semantically after JSON parsing and BFF normalization: an integer value within bounds is required; JSON 3 and 3.0 are equivalent and both accepted as integer 3; 3.5, strings, booleans, negative-where-prohibited and out-of-range values are rejected; strings are never coerced; the digest is computed over the parsed, validated representation (integer 3). Owner-approved W5-0 documentation rule, 2026-10-27
canonical-json/1.undefined: impossible in JSON; rejected client-side before hashing
canonical-json/1.unicode: Unicode scalar values only; lone surrogates rejected; no normalization

algorithms.client-fingerprint/1: lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical-json/1 of {"scope":{"actor","deployment","order"},"payload"}; identical to frontend attempt.ts digest({scope,payload})
algorithms.business-fingerprint/lifecycle/1: PROPOSED: SHA-256 of canonical {version:1, sales_order_id, kind, phase, expected_epoch, progress_revision, mode?, confirmed?, reason?, counts?[sorted by allocation_id]}; absent optional members omitted

barcode_rules.identity: byte-exact, leading zeros preserved, no trim, no normalization
